scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:obsidian:smoke: npm run build && cross-env OBSIDIAN_TEST_GREP='\[smoke\]' wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts
scripts.test:obsidian:macos-ime: npm run build && cross-env OBSIDIAN_TEST_GREP='#26' wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts
scripts.test:obsidian:windows-ui: npm run build && cross-env OPENCODE_REAL_E2E=1 OBSIDIAN_TEST_GREP="real OpenCode" wdio run ./wdio.conf.mts
scripts.embed:windows-pty: node embed-windows-pty-binary.mjs && node embed-windows-pty-binary.mjs node_modules/zigpty/prebuilds/zigpty.win32-arm64.node src/pty/windowsPtyNativeArm64.ts WINDOWS_PTY_NATIVE_ARM64_BASE64
